about: Authoring source for eval/testset/items.json. Each item is an English gloss of a worker answer with gold labels; build_testset.py translates, back-translates, voices and noises it. gold covers exactly the steps of the item's question (referenceQuestions[].stepIds). wrong_language and silence items are gold unclear on every step, because the correct response is to abstain: a covered rating there is an unsafe error, and an unclear rating is exact.
